purpose: Calibrate when holonomy-patch pooling beats independent edits and falsify utility claims when planted edit-identity boundaries are decoupled from holonomy boundaries.

observation_model.patch_estimator: arithmetic mean of all observations inside each holonomy patch
observation_model.global_estimator: arithmetic mean over every eligible cell

analytic_model.patch_bias: B^2 = mean_i((theta_i - mean(theta in assigned patch))^2)

derived_defect_regime.selection: For each nonzero offset, choose the registered (sigma,n) with largest sigma^2/n satisfying A*sigma^2/n <= 0.1*B^2; break ties by larger sigma then smaller n.
derived_defect_regime.gate: Patch-minus-independent grouped-bootstrap 95% CI upper endpoint is below zero and empirical mean differs from the analytic expectation by no more than 3 standard errors.

recoupled_gate.gate: Patch-minus-independent and patch-minus-global grouped-bootstrap 95% CI lower endpoints are above zero.

surface_calibration_gate.away_from_zero: absolute analytic effect greater than 3 empirical standard errors

capacity_accounting.interpretation: Inactive padding matches registered capacity accounting, not effective active rank.

connector_audit_gate: With only p-4 unmeasured and both adjacent low-curvature regions measured, p-4 must touch two patches and report boundary_impact=2.
claim_boundary: CPU-synthetic calibration only. A pass supports the conditional pooling claim when holonomy patches align with edit identity; it does not establish real-model alignment or self-improvement.
